Covington Capital Management increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 6.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Covington Capital Management bought 2,229 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 39,017 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.89 million, up from 36,788 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Covington Capital Management who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.22 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.23% or $2.24 during the last trading session, reaching $184.9. About 7.96 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Perigon Wealth Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 17.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Perigon Wealth Management Llc sold 17,365 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 80,535 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.63M, down from 97,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Perigon Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.03 billion market cap company.
